result.topic_en: A theorem with proof on the divisibility of a function X modulo p^m by a quantity ξ modulo p^δ, given an expansion of X in powers of ξ with conditions on the exponents; a short unrelated linear equation sketch appears at the bottom.
result.transcription:
Theorema.
si $X$ (Mod. $p^m$) ; per $\xi$ Mod $p^\delta$ diuidatur i.e.
si $X$ formae [-$\xi$c-] $Ap^m + \xi B p^{m'} + \xi^2 C p^{m''} \ldots$
et omnes $m'+\delta$, $m''+2\delta$, $m'''+3\delta \ldots$ non $< m$
[-nec vero-] [-omnes-] [-vero-] {+aliquae+} $m'+\delta-1$, $m''+2\delta-2$, $m'''+3\delta-3\ldots$ $\lessgtr$[?] $m$
Itque
$X = \xi\varphi + Ap^m$ et
$\varphi$ Mod $p^{m-\delta}$ per $\xi'$ [-Mod-] diuidi possit
$X$ Mod $p^m$ etiam per $\xi'$ diuidi poterit.
[-Sit-] Dem. Sit $\varphi = \xi'\varphi' + Mp^{m-\delta}$
erit
$X = \xi'.\xi\varphi' + M\xi p^{m-\delta}$

$A + Bx + Cy + Dz = 0$
$y = a + bx$
$z = c + dx$

methods.what: Criterion for divisibility of X modulo p^m by ξ modulo p^δ via an expansion in powers of ξ with exponent conditions
methods.quote:
si $X$ formae [-$\xi$c-] $Ap^m + \xi B p^{m'} + \xi^2 C p^{m''} \ldots$
et omnes $m'+\delta$, $m''+2\delta$, $m'''+3\delta \ldots$ non $< m$

methods.what: Transitivity of divisibility: if X = ξφ + Ap^m and φ is divisible by ξ' mod p^{m-δ}, then X is divisible by ξ' mod p^m
methods.quote:
$X = \xi\varphi + Ap^m$ et
$\varphi$ Mod $p^{m-\delta}$ per $\xi'$ [-Mod-] diuidi possit
$X$ Mod $p^m$ etiam per $\xi'$ diuidi poterit.

methods.what: Proof by substitution of φ = ξ'φ' + Mp^{m-δ}
methods.quote:
Dem. Sit $\varphi = \xi'\varphi' + Mp^{m-\delta}$
erit
$X = \xi'.\xi\varphi' + M\xi p^{m-\delta}$

methods.what: Linear equation in x, y, z with y and z expressed linearly in x (substitution)
methods.quote:
$A + Bx + Cy + Dz = 0$
$y = a + bx$
$z = c + dx$

items.english: X = ξφ + Ap^m, and if φ modulo p^{m-δ} can be divided by ξ', then X modulo p^m can also be divided by ξ'.
